status: PROPOSAL by the operator (Claude Code), written 2026-10-05 before any question exists and before model B has run. It has no force. The owner decides every word. The signed table is a separate file, optionb/OUTCOME_STATUS_TABLE.json, written from the owner's own words.
what_this_is: For every code the option B programs can print, the one status word of the spec sheet legend (docs/CAS_HARNESS_SPEC_SHEET.md, section 3) that the result row would carry. Fixing it now means nobody picks a word after seeing the result.

proposed_groups.legend_meaning: A single pre-registered test met its stated criterion.
proposed_groups.note: The only pass. Even then no outside claim is licensed: the plan requires a repeat on fresh passages first. The exploratory ending stays in the code, so the row shows the small size.

proposed_groups.legend_meaning: A single pre-registered test did not meet its stated criterion.
proposed_groups.note: A failed condition is a failure, never a pass with notes. The code itself says which conditions held.

proposed_groups.legend_meaning: The test could not be read because a precondition failed. The claim was never tested, rather than tested and rejected.
proposed_groups.note: Questions too easy or too hard for model B, replies not in the asked form, notes not read, or questions guessable without the passage.

proposed_groups.legend_meaning: The run is unusable for reasons unrelated to the hypothesis. Its numbers may never be cited.
proposed_groups.note: A program fault, a broken length match, too little time, or no readable result file.

one_line_to_sign_as_proposed: SIGNED: option B status table as proposed (PASS / FAIL / VACUOUS / VOID groups).
how_to_change_one: Add: except <CODE> = <legend word>. Only the pass code may carry a pass word; a code that ends in _EXPLORATORY may not carry VALIDATED or LICENSED (plan limits L1 to L5).
